verdict.rationale: The core product is an MIT-licensed set of skill files. The installer writes them into your own repo as ordinary editable files you own, with nothing updating behind your back, and they work with any agent or model. A hands-on probe confirmed a keyless, non-interactive install that copies a skill locally, so the product runs entirely on the user's own setup with no hosted dependency. Missing for 10: no explicit self-hosting or offline/mirrored install documentation (the installer fetches from GitHub via `npx skills`), and no independent corroboration beyond the single install probe.
